packs.name: Core Compliance Pack

packs.name: ISO/IEC 27001 Fast Start

packs.standard_version: Current UK GDPR and ICO guidance at 2026-08-03

packs.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Fast Start
packs.customer_goal: Generate AI inventory, impact assessments, risk, oversight, transparency, monitoring, incident and supplier records.
